page_title: CLE 4-1 REI | Clermont v Reims 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Florent Batta is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+5' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+4' The total number of attempts is 12:10.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 4 - 1 Goal! Jeremy Jacquet displays great vision and sends a pass to Elbasan Rashani (Clermont), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 4:1.
89' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) comes onto the pitch after Grejohn Kyei signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
88' Looks like Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.

85' Reda Khadra (Reims) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
83' Clermont quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Johan Gastien (Clermont) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. Clermont have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Alan Virginius and he is replaced by Chrislain Matsima (Clermont).
80' Substitution. Mehdi Zeffane makes his way off the pitch and Jeremy Jacquet (Clermont) comes on as his replacement.
79' 3 - 1 Goal Elbasan Rashani (Clermont)! Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) was put through by Grejohn Kyei and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
77' Thibault De Smet (Reims) is given his marching orders with a straight red card! For us, it was a very harsh one.
77' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Adama Bojang (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Reims will take a corner.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Junya Ito as he is replaced by Adama Bojang (Reims).
73' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Habib Keita (Clermont) replacing Muhammed Cham.
73' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
70' Keito Nakamura (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
67' Substitution. Amir Richardson on for Therence Koudou (Reims).
66' The substitution has been made. Reda Khadra (Reims) has replaced Amadou Kone.
66' Will Still has decided to make a change. Thomas Foket (Reims) replaces Teddy Teuma.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is brought on as a substitute for Oumar Diakite.
60' Teddy Teuma (Reims) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
59' Amadou Kone (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florent Batta had an easy-decision to make.
56' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Muhammed Cham (Clermont) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Yehvann Diouf no chance!
55' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is going to take the penalty!
54' Yellow card. Therence Koudou (Reims) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
54' Clermont are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick! Florent Batta interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Therence Koudou (Reims).

52' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Yehvann Diouf pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
52' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
48' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Keito Nakamura (Reims) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
48' Oumar Diakite (Reims) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
46' Neto Borges (Clermont) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) forces a pass into the box, but Mory Diaw is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
40' Clermont take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

38' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Marshall Munetsi (Reims) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
38' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
34' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Yehvann Diouf has no trouble gathering it.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Keito Nakamura (Reims) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Yehvann Diouf gets a hand on the penalty from Muhammed Cham (Clermont), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
30' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) handles the ball inside the box. No point in arguing there. Clermont will take a penalty kick.
29' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is penalised for holding. Florent Batta signals a set piece.
28' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mory Diaw intercepts the ball.
27' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Neto Borges (Clermont) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
24' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is penalised for a foul. Florent Batta had a clear view and blows his whistle.
22' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner but it's cleared.
22' Therence Koudou (Reims) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Corner kick. Reims will have an opportunity.
21' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the effort.
21' Clermont are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
20' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) sends the corner into the box, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts it and averts the threat.
15' A pass into the penalty area from Johan Gastien (Clermont) is intercepted by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Clermont.
12' Clermont work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
11' Reims couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mory Diaw (Clermont) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
10' Yohan Magnin (Clermont) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Clermont seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Reims will kick-off.
Florent Batta was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
